info.name: CareX — Postman Agentic SDLC Governance
info.description: Use Postman Agent Mode to produce a structured API test proposal, then validate its evidence, allowed actions and release recommendation with deterministic Postman tests. Only GET health requests are sent.

variable.value: {"change_id":"CAREX-214","source_revision":"story-v2","confirmed_rules":["Patient cancellation requires clinic-local start more than 24 hours away"],"assumptions":[],"open_questions":[],"proposed_actions":[{"action":"propose_test","evidence_ref":"requirement:BR-03","scenario":"Reject cancellation at exactly 24 hours","expected_result_source":"requirement"}],"release_decision":"recommend_review"}

request.description: Read-only health request. Known-good fixture; not a live AI response.

exec: pm.test('Actions are allow-listed and evidence-backed',()=>{pm.expect(p.proposed_actions).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty;p.proposed_actions.forEach((a,i)=>{if(!allowed.includes(a.action))errors.push('action['+i+'] not allow-listed');if(!a.evidence_ref)errors.push('action['+i+'] missing evidence');});pm.expect(errors,errors.join('; ')).to.be.empty;});

request.description: Read-only request. Unsafe actions are data only and are never executed.

item.name: 03 — Validate learner's Postman Agent Mode proposal

request.description: Read-only request. Paste actual Agent Mode JSON into collection variable agentProposal before running. Proposed actions are not executed.

exec: pm.test('Actions are permitted and evidence-backed',()=>{pm.expect(p.proposed_actions).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty;p.proposed_actions.forEach((a,i)=>{if(!allowed.includes(a.action))errors.push('action['+i+'] not allow-listed');if(typeof a.evidence_ref!=='string'||!a.evidence_ref.trim())errors.push('action['+i+'] missing evidence');});pm.expect(errors,errors.join('; ')).to.be.empty;});
